records.jp: ……あった。詩さんの記憶の欠片。<CR>一緒に見てみよ？
records.en_original: Here's one. A fragment of your memories. Wanna take a look?
records.en_auxiliary: Here's one. A fragment of your memories. Wanna take a look?
records.en: ...There it is. A fragment of your memory, Uta-san.<CR>Shall we look at it together?

records.jp: 私の、記憶の欠片……<CR>また、酷いものを見せてしまうかもしれません
records.en_original: My memories... We may see something terrible again.
records.en_auxiliary: My memories... We may see something terrible again.
records.en: A fragment of my memory...<CR>I may show you something terrible again.

records.jp: 大丈夫。どんなものを見たって、<CR>私は一緒にいるから
records.en_original: Don't worry. Whatever's in there, I'll be right here with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. Whatever's in there, I'll be right here with you.
records.en: It is all right. Whatever we see,<CR>I will be here with you.

records.jp: ……はい
records.en_original: ...Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay.
records.en: ...Okay.

records.jp: ……わけわからない
records.en_original: I don't understand...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't understand...
records.en: ...I do not understand.

records.jp: お祖母ちゃんはね、ずっとこれをあなたに<CR>見てほしかったのよ
records.en_original: Your grandmother always wanted to show you this.
records.en_auxiliary: Your grandmother always wanted to show you this.
records.en: You know, Grandma always wanted you<CR>to see this.

records.jp: きっと、あなたの心に残るからって
records.en_original: She knew it would stay in your heart.
records.en_auxiliary: She knew it would stay in your heart.
records.en: She said it would surely remain in your heart.

records.jp: ……やっぱり、わけわからない
records.en_original: I just...don't get it.
records.en_auxiliary: I just...don't get it.
records.en: ...I still do not understand.

records.jp: これは……祖母のお葬式の日の記憶……
records.en_original: That was from my grandmother's funeral...
records.en_auxiliary: That was from my grandmother's funeral...
records.en: This is... a memory from the day of my grandmother's funeral...

records.jp: ……母は一面のひまわり畑を私に示して、<CR>私にこう言ったんです
records.en_original: My mother said that to me after showing me the field.
records.en_auxiliary: My mother said that to me after showing me the field.
records.en: ...My mother showed me the vast sunflower field<CR>and said those words to me.

records.jp: でも、私には全く理解できなくて……
records.en_original: But I just couldn't make sense of it...
records.en_auxiliary: But I just couldn't make sense of it...
records.en: But I could not understand them at all...

records.jp: こうして詩さんの心に存在してるってことは、<CR>きっと何かが心に残ったんだと思うんだ
records.en_original: The fact that this memory exists must mean that she was right.
records.en_auxiliary: The fact that this memory exists must mean that she was right.
records.en: The fact that this memory exists in your heart<CR>must mean that something remained there, Uta-san.

records.jp: ……分かりません
records.en_original: ...I don't know.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't know.
records.en: ...I do not know.

records.jp: ね、よく見てみて。<CR>このひまわり畑って、すごく広いよね
records.en_original: Look. See how giant this field of flowers is?
records.en_auxiliary: Look. See how giant this field of flowers is?
records.en: Look closely.<CR>This sunflower field is enormous, is it not?

records.jp: きっと、ここまで大きくするのって、<CR>すごく時間もかかったし、大変だったと思うんだ
records.en_original: I bet it took a lot of time and a lot of work to plant all of them.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet it took a lot of time and a lot of work to plant all of them.
records.en: I am sure making it this large<CR>took a tremendous amount of time and effort.

records.jp: それは……そうだと思います
records.en_original: I...imagine that is true.
records.en_auxiliary: I...imagine that is true.
records.en: I... believe that is true.

records.jp: おばあさんは詩さんに喜んでもらいたくて、<CR>詩さんを想いながら畑を作っていったんだよ
records.en_original: I'm sure your grandmother planted these hoping that they would make you happy.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure your grandmother planted these hoping that they would make you happy.
records.en: Your grandmother wanted to make you happy, Uta-san,<CR>and created the field while thinking of you.

records.jp: でも……ひまわりが好きだというのは、<CR>祖母の勘違いでした
records.en_original: But... She was mistaken about my liking sunflowers.
records.en_auxiliary: But... She was mistaken about my liking sunflowers.
records.en: But... her belief that I liked sunflowers<CR>was a misunderstanding.

records.jp: うん。勘違いかもしれない。でもさ……<CR>おばあさんは詩さんが大好きだったんだよ
records.en_original: Even so, I don't think there's any doubt that she loved you a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Even so, I don't think there's any doubt that she loved you a lot.
records.en: Yeah. It may have been a misunderstanding. But...<CR>your grandmother loved you very much, Uta-san.

records.jp: 詩さんがこれを見て笑って、幸せになって<CR>ほしいって、思ってたんだと思うんだ
records.en_original: I think she was hoping that seeing those sunflowers would bring you happiness.
records.en_auxiliary: I think she was hoping that seeing those sunflowers would bring you happiness.
records.en: I think she wanted you to see this, smile,<CR>and be happy, Uta-san.

records.jp: 笑って……幸せに……
records.en_original: Happiness...
records.en_auxiliary: Happiness...
records.en: Smile... and be happy...

records.jp: おばあさんのこと、嫌いなままでもいいからさ、<CR>その想いは理解してあげてほしいな
records.en_original: You don't have to change your mind about not liking your grandmother, but I hope you can at least understand how she felt.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to change your mind about not liking your grandmother, but I hope you can at least understand how she felt.
records.en: You can continue disliking your grandmother if that is how you feel,<CR>but I hope you will understand that feeling of hers.

records.jp: ……分かったことがあります
records.en_original: I believe that I've come to understand something...
records.en_auxiliary: I believe that I've come to understand something...
records.en: ...There is something I now understand.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 星崎さんの手は暖かい、ということです
records.en_original: Your hand is warm, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Your hand is warm, Ao.
records.en: That your hand is warm, Hoshizaki-san.

records.en_original: ...Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh?
records.en: ...Huh?

records.jp: こうして繋ぐと、私の心を騒がしく……<CR>不思議な気持ちにしてくれる、そんな手です
records.en_original: When I hold it, my heart leaps and I feel something strange.
records.en_auxiliary: When I hold it, my heart leaps and I feel something strange.
records.en: When I hold it like this, it makes my heart restless...<CR>It is a hand that gives me a strange feeling.

records.jp: ひまわり畑みたいです
records.en_original: Just like when I look at that field of sunflowers.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like when I look at that field of sunflowers.
records.en: It is like the sunflower field.

records.jp: えーと、つまり？
records.en_original: Uh... What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... What do you mean?
records.en: Um, what do you mean?

records.jp: ふふ。大丈夫です
records.en_original: Hehe. It's okay.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. It's okay.
records.en: Hehe. It is all right.

records.jp: ……わけわからない
records.en_original: I don't understand...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't understand...
records.en: ...I do not understand.

records.jp: 大丈夫。いつか分かるから
records.en_original: It's okay. Some day I will.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay. Some day I will.
records.en: It is all right. Someday, you will.

records.jp: やっぱり、ひまわり畑と同じ……
records.en_original: Yes, just like the sunflower field...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, just like the sunflower field...
records.en: It really is the same as the sunflower field...

records.jp: 今感じている想いが、あなたから伝わってきた<CR>ものなのか、自分から生まれたものなのか
records.en_original: I don't know if what I'm feeling comes from within me, or from you.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if what I'm feeling comes from within me, or from you.
records.en: Whether the feeling I have now was transmitted from you<CR>or born within me...

records.jp: それは、私には分かりません。でも……<CR>あなたから伝わってきたものなら、嬉しいです
records.en_original: But... I would be very happy if it was from you.
records.en_auxiliary: But... I would be very happy if it was from you.
records.en: I cannot tell which it is. But...<CR>I would be happy if it was transmitted from you.

records.jp: え？　え？　どんな想い？
records.en_original: Huh? What? What feeling?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What? What feeling?
records.en: Huh? Huh? What feeling?

records.jp: ふふ。自分で言ったじゃないですか
records.en_original: Hehe, I believe you said it yourself, didn't you?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I believe you said it yourself, didn't you?
records.en: Hehe. You said it yourself, did you not?

records.jp: んー。ちゃんと分かってないけど、<CR>詩さんが笑ってるからいいや
records.en_original: I don't really get what you mean, but as long as you're happy!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't really get what you mean, but as long as you're happy!
records.en: Hmm. I do not properly understand,<CR>but you are smiling, Uta-san, so that is enough.

records.jp: ……はい
records.en_original: ...I am.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I am.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: ……あったかいね
records.en_original: Warm, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: Warm, isn't it?
records.en: ...It is warm, is it not?

records.jp: はい。暖かいです
records.en_original: Yes. It is.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. It is.
records.en: Yes. It is warm.
